title: Miracles of Jesus Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Miracles of Jesus Bible Crossword
description: Solve a miracles of Jesus Bible crossword: water into wine, the blind man, Lazarus, the loaves and fishes. KJV clues, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: This is the wide-angle puzzle: not one miracle but the whole range of them, from a wedding in Cana that ran out of wine to a grave in Bethany four days old. Miracles of Jesus asks you to place each sign with its place and its detail — the pool with five porches, the withered hand, the ten lepers and the one who came back.

If you want a single miracle at length, the archive has Walking on Water, Calming the Storm and Feeding the Five Thousand as puzzles of their own. This one closes on John's note that there were many others besides.

clues.text: What the water became at the marriage in Cana
Raised in Bethany, brother of Mary and Martha
Pool with five porches where the impotent man lay
Loaves that fed the five thousand

verseText: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
